title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S17 E05 — Secrets of Mexico's Underworld
Josh joins archeologists as they bushwhack through thick jungles and rappel into vast caves in search of the lost Zoque culture.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S15 E02 — The Man-Eating Lions of Kenya
Josh braves the African savanna to investigate the rampage of two lions who killed as many as 135 railroad workers in 1898; to prevent more bloodshed, Josh joins wildlife rangers tracking a pair of rogue lions who are on a modern-day killing spree.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S15 E05 — Treasure of the Pirate Queen
Josh braves the South Carolina swamps to search for the lost treasure of the infamous Anne Bonny; the pirate queen used her wits, beauty and daring to steal millions in booty; Josh may have unearthed Anne's secret trading post.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S05 E02 — American Atlantis
An abandoned town in the Nevada desert is the ruins of an American Atlantis, destroyed by catastrophic floods when the Hoover Dam was built; experts investigate the secrets of this eerie ghost town as water levels recede and the city reemerges.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E02 — Try That in a Shine Town
An unshackled Digger leads Amanda to where he last saw Popcorn Sutton's stainless steel still; Richard and Mike's uneasy alliance faces a common threat when an extortionist shine boss demands payment; Josh modifies a vehicle, returning to the woods.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E03 — Curse of the Skinwalkers
A series of terrifying encounters in the Navajo Nation has renewed fears of the legendary Skinwalker. With the help of a local expert, Phil and Heather journey deep into a cursed valley and investigate a cave that few dare to enter.

title: Orange County Choppers Original
description:
S01 E03 — Moving Over
Orange County Choppers Original brings the legendary shop back to its roots -- real bikes, real stories, and the raw, unfiltered energy that made OCC a household name.

title: Destination Dive
description:
S03 E04 — Hidden Dive Treasures of the Lower Keys
In this episode, we spotlight the remarkable groups working behind the scenes to support divers, empower scientists, and push the boundaries of what's possible in ocean conservation.

title: RV There Yet?
description:
S05 E08 — Billings, MT
Patrice and Kevin McCabe attend the 150th anniversary celebration of Little Big Horn Day with a re-enactment of Custer's Last Stand and a visit to Chief Plenty Coup State Park.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E15 — Aleutian Solution
Sig's crew races to jettison pots and repair a flooding compartment below deck. Rick radios Johnathan to help hide his honey hole, but when Jake spots the Time Bandit's unusual movements, he calls Rick's bluff.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E16 — Contagion
As Jake sets gear in heavy seas, a painful skin infection spreads among the Cornelia Marie crew.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S02 E03 — Helene's Appalachian Hellscape
Hurricane Helene barrels north into Appalachia, dumping 30 inches of rain; as hundreds of cameras capture flooding and mudslides, one woman gets swept away by the deluge, until a man attending a wedding rehearsal jumps into the water to save her.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E04 — Houston Hurricane Hell
When Hurricane Harvey hit Texas with 130 mph winds and record-breaking rain, cameras captured catastrophic flooding as entire neighborhoods vanished, forcing civilians to risk their own lives to save others.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S03 E06 — Escaping the LA Fires
When wind-driven fires explode across Los Angeles in January 2025, cameras capture chaos and heroism as residents attempt to rescue loved ones and flee burning neighborhoods.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E02 — That Car's Flying!
Hurricane Idalia sweeps away coastal homes and flips a car 350 miles away.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S03 E01 — The Texas Flood
Unrelenting rainfall in central Texas turns the Fourth of July into a fight for survival.

title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
description:
S01 E04 — Typhoon Warning
Stung by Patrick's criticism, Allison gathers debris to craft an improvised fishing net; a tropical storm pounds all four camps; Mandy and Adam must abandon their battered shelter and push into the dense jungle.

title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
description:
S01 E05 — Smoke Signals and Fire Fights
Spotting smoke on a distant shore, a team pushes to find another camp; the jungle trek has Mandy at her breaking point; Dani and Jarrell's clashing survival styles spark a blowout fight; a survivalist is medically evacuated from the challenge.

title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
description:
S01 E06 — Spewing and Stinging Venom
Dani and Jarrell's heated fight splinters their camp, forcing Jamie to pick sides. A dangerous hunt leads to a shocking food win in another camp. As teams merge, dynamics begin to shift. An agonizing stingray attack puts a survivalist at risk.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S03 E02 — Great Lakes Monster
A rare, powerful weather system races 1,000 miles across the Great Lakes, unleashing damaging tornadoes in Canada's capital city, Ottawa.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E07 — Stranded in St. Louis
In May 2025, eyewitnesses capture scenes of destruction as a mile-wide tornado tears through the city of St. Louis; when warning sirens fail, residents are caught off guard while visitors panic 630 feet above the ground inside the Gateway Arch.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S06 E08 — Target Identified
Bryce, Mireya, Russell and Biko converge at the high-activity area in "The Fork," which is equipped with state-of-the-art tech; as the interceptor drone and seismic tripwire activate, the team is led to a discovery they've never seen before.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E03 — Beer Before Liquor
Digger and Amanda's plan to distill beer in Popcorn Sutton's old still hits a wall; Jerry designs an innovative still that combines multiple shine recipes in a single run; Josh's mission to surprise his partners leaves him with a vanload of peaches.

title: MythBusters
description:
S06 E11 — Coffin Punch
The whole team gets together to test myths about survival; in Coffin Punch, Kari, Tory and Grant test the silver screen saga; Adam and Jamie question what bullet-proof is.

title: MythBusters
description:
S06 E05 — Phone Book Friction
Adam and Jamie take a fan mail film and use it to dial in on a phone book fable; the rest of the team test a fishy tale of Hollywood pyrotechnics with their own big bang theories.

title: MythBusters
description:
S07 E02 — Alaska Special 2
The teams get some Northern exposure.

title: MythBusters
description:
S14 E04 — Indy Car Special
The MythBusters go to the Indianapolis Motor Speedway to test racing myths.

title: MythBusters
description:
S15 E08 — Supersonic Ping Pong; Ice Cannon
Supersonic ping pong; lighting a frozen fuse on an ice cannon.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S01 E02 — Hunting for Silver Bullets
Matt tackles a dangerous, ten-acre hoard in the Pennsylvania woods to hunt high-value guns and ammo; the old-school machinist's property is packed with heavy equipment and scrap metal, but $25,000 worth of precious metal could make a bet pay off.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S01 E06 — Digging for Man Cave Treasure
Matt hunts for rare liquor, hand-rolled cigars and vintage drums in two California hoards; when the owners refuse to part with key items, Matt's bottom line is threatened.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S01 E04 — Amping up the Mess and Money
Matt takes on a rock star mess to find classic guitars and amps, vintage trucks and rare Harleys; the hoard's heavy metal puts the team at risk.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E01 — Big Bangs for Big Bucks
Matt tackles a hoard packed with high-value vintage toys and hidden loaded guns; Matt test-drives a 1960s British sports car and test-fires the weapons at a local gun range; lowball bids force the team to find new buyers; total sales top $100,000.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E06 — Santa's Fury Road to Riches
Matt scrambles to clear a bat-infested barn and turn a sea of Santa Clauses into big money; while tackling jobs in Michigan and Massachusetts, Matt finds a lost cache of rare coins; a '64 Plymouth Fury could be a score if the owner decides to sell.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E02 — Fab Four and a Big Score
A police officer's house in North Carolina is packed with fishing gear, rare Beatles records, guns and knives; in Tennessee, sports memorabilia has taken over a family's home; total sales top $100,000; a client is moved to give Matt a tribute.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E01 — Washington Parish Jail
Over-capacity and on the brink, Louisiana's Washington Parish Jail is spiraling into chaos; the new sheriff struggles to bring stability and control while facing the mistakes of the past.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E04 — Wood County Jail
After nearly two decades of economic decline and a surge in methamphetamine use, Wood County, Wisconsin opens a new $93 million jail, where staff faces mounting pressure to help a community searching for a way forward.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E07 — Anderson County Jail
Anderson County, Tennessee, is federally recognized as an area affected by drug trafficking and gangs. With only one county jail, Sheriff Barker and his team combat crime while offering unique inmate reentry programs that reduce recidivism.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E10 — Super-load Sunday
Officers are caught off guard when a high-end sports car arrives at the border packing heat. At the bus terminal, a K9 alerts to a traveler's luggage. Upon investigation, officers find photographs showing large amounts of cash on her phone.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E08 — San Joaquin County Jail
At the crossroads of one of the West Coast's busiest narcotics corridors, Sheriff Patrick Withrow and his deputies confront violent offenders, rival gangs and the ongoing battle to stop contraband from entering California's San Joaquin County Jail.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E02 — I Don't Practice Santeria
With cartels using drones, a newly formed CBP drone strike unit is taking aim at cartel eyes in the sky; an officer suspects that a vehicle may be carrying more than some innocent Santeria sprays.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E03 — The Breeder's Cup
Officers find an 18-wheeler carrying more than a load of takeout containers; a couple raises suspicion after declaring bulldog semen, but the labeling suggests the box may actually contain stallion semen, a valuable and tightly regulated substance.

title: Street Outlaws: Locals Only
description:
S02 E12 — Mr. Michigan
Michiganders compete for $5,000, and a racing wagon surprises everyone. Then, the last local standing goes up against Bobby Ducote for another $5,000 -- but Bobby's car is ready to back up his big mouth, and it won't be an easy negotiation.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E04 — The Drunkest President
Tickle unearths a source of spring water for Josh's peach brandy; Tim sets out to resurrect a spirit that fueled America's most intoxicated president; Mike convinces Richard to ignore an extortion attempt and risk angering a mob boss.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E01 — Born Tax-Free
Tim rejoins Tickle on the outlaw side as Canadian tariffs open a new market; with police on their trail, Mark and Digger revive old-time tactics; Josh heads to the Carolina hills to reinvent his family recipe with a new ingredient.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E02 — Outlaw Redemption
Tim and Tickle bottle their first illegal run together in 14 years; Mark and Digger reintroduce their corn liquor to the outlaw market, only to find their price undercut by a competitor; Josh gets a wake-up call about the law.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E03 — Proof or Consequences
Mark and Digger reverse-engineer a counterfeit jar of shine that is flooding the outlaw market; when Josh discovers footprints near his still site, he reopens the underground bunker site he built a decade ago; Jerry helps Mike design.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E04 — Stashes to Ashes
Poised to bootleg their first tariff-free liquor to Canada, Tim and Tickle encounter armed opposition hellbent on torching their plans.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E05 — Dead Drops Don't Lie
When Mark and Huck's shine stash vanishes, the hunt for culprits sparks explosive plans for revenge.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E08 — Washoe County Jail
Inside one of Nevada's busiest jails, deputies battle a non-stop surge of arrests driven by Reno's constant crime and a major trafficking corridor; with gangs entrenched inside, keeping rival groups apart becomes a daily fight for control.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E04 — Caddo Parish Correctional Center
Caddo Parish Correctional Center is struggling with a staffing shortage, the inmates outnumber the deputies by 180 to one; to ensure the safety of both inmates and staff alike, the Emergency Response Team springs into action.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E05 — San Francisco County Jail
In a city gripped by fentanyl and rising drug arrests, San Francisco's largest jail is on the front lines of addiction; it fights to give inmates a shot at recovery, rehabilitation and a path forward.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E06 — Flagler County Jail
At Florida's Flagler County Jail, law and order Sheriff Rick Staly takes a tough approach to corrections while battling the revolving door of repeat offenders through discipline, rehabilitation, and recovery programs.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E08 — San Joaquin County Jail
At the crossroads of one of the West Coast's busiest narcotics corridors, Sheriff Patrick Withrow and his deputies confront violent offenders, rival gangs and the ongoing battle to stop contraband from entering California's San Joaquin County Jail.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S01 E06 — Texas Tornado
When a tornado outbreak strikes Texas and Kansas in 2022, hundreds of eyewitnesses find themselves trapped in the path; as they seek the best shelter they can find, they capture the moments when tornadoes destroy the very structures around them.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S01 E03 — Hellfire in Hawaii
Maui faces the worst natural disaster in 2023, as hurricane-force winds fuel wildfires that catch residents off guard; as eyewitnesses attempt to flee the flames, they film their attempts to escape from the eye of the storm.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S01 E02 — Derecho Superstorm
Hundreds of eyewitnesses film their attempts to escape when a derecho superstorm blasts through Nebraska and Iowa in 2020; then it happens again, only this time, the hurricane-force winds come wrapped in a dust storm.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S01 E04 — Half-Country Hurricane
Showcasing how Hurricane Ida hit the Louisiana coast in 2021 and features films from eyewitnesses as tornadoes and flooding hit all the way to New York City.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S02 E04 — Nebraska Super Outbreak
In April 2024, dozens of tornadoes ravaged NE's Central Plains; eyewitnesses find themselves in the wrong place at the wrong time as twisters tear through neighborhoods, demolish massive commercial structures, and topple semi-trailers.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S02 E06 — Terrifying Twin Twisters
In May 2024, dozens of eyewitnesses capture rare twin tornadoes as they carve a parallel path of destruction across Iowa; with winds near 300 mph, the twister sisters topple farms, shred wind turbines and devastate the town of Greenfield.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S03 E04 — Category 5: Fight to Survive
After hitting Category five, Hurricane Ian slams Florida's Gulf Coast with 150 mph winds and a storm surge that sweeps away homes.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E03 — Monster in Michigan
When a rare EF-3 tornado touches down in northern Michigan, cameras capture the chaos and disbelief.

description:
S02 E07 — Ultra High Proof
Distillers compete to make a Prohibition-era classic; moonshine up to an ultra-high 180 proof; building their own stills and mash; judging are Mark, Digger, Tim and guest Mark Rogers.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E05 — Quarter Ton of Backwoods Fun
Amanda and Kelly attempt to reinvent an Appalachian apple brandy made famous by a 500-pound woman; Mark and Digger lend Popcorn Sutton's condenser to a new team of shiners; Richard and Jerry find a common cause, putting Mike in the hot seat.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E04 — Rollercoaster Accidents
Drill down on maintenance and safety lapses that derailed amusement park rides.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E05 — Skyscraper Collapses
Pinpoint the mistakes that cause major structural failures; explore the preventable explosion inside London's Ronan Point; the code violations that collapsed Lalita Park; the short circuit that set off a deadly fire in Tehran's Plasco Building.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E06 — Nuclear Plant Disasters
Hunt for the root cause of atomic accidents; examine the Windscale fire, which led to safer reactor designs; learn why swift crisis management helped in the Three Mile Island incident; see why improper waste disposal fuelled the Kyshtym disaster.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E01 — The Tesla Terrorizer
A woman is caught on camera defecating on a car; a man makes off with a tow truck, wreaking havoc through the streets of New York City.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E04 — The Mystery Pistol Packer
Tizzy tries to identify a man filmed pulling a gun on skateboarders; a road rager who reportedly used his coffee cup as a weapon is identified by his tattoos; a confrontation over a car charger leaves a woman seeking Tizzy's help.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E05 — The Nightmare Neighbor
Tizzy sparks an internet movement to end a woman's racially charged harassment of her neighbors; a parking lot guard is targeted by a driver; a disgruntled customer wrecks a GameStop.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S09 E03 — Ransom in the Sky
Josh looks to finally crack the D. B. Cooper case, America's only unsolved skyjacking; a deathbed confession and cutting-edge forensics have Josh hot on the trail of the $200,000 ransom that's never been recovered.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S07 E08 — Cracking the Secret
Josh Gates goes on a nationwide treasure hunt to solve a mystery no one has cracked for 40 years: The Secret; Josh travels coast-to-coast and back in time using cutting-edge augmented reality and tapping into a network of obsessed Secret detectives.
